svg.text: Public artifacts become richer over time, but trajectory availability and token telemetry remain different things.
2023-03 onward: no standardized historical corpus located
2023-06 onward: usually absent; one very large archive remains license/schema blocked
2023 onward: heterogeneous, often aggregate/cost-only, and frequently license-ambiguous
2023-07 onward: mostly absent or aggregate and non-comparable
2025 through evidence cutoff 2026-07-18: interfaces exist; no universal public task/outcome corpus
n=7 historical eras | measurement: primary-source discovery map | no token totals inferred for missing eras
